mapper.select: SELECT c.id FROM destination_comments c LEFT JOIN content_moderations cm ON cm.target_type = 'DESTINATION_COMMENT' AND cm.target_id = c.id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.destination_id = #{destinationId} AND c.parent_comment_id IS NULL AND c.rating IS NOT NULL AND (c.deleted = 0 OR cm.id IS NOT NULL) AND c.id != #{excludeId} ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
